name: Dora Leung
office: City of Monterey Park, City Clerk

items.text: Dora Leung is running for Monterey Park City Clerk. She previously worked as a Los Angeles County election clerk, and served as Monterey Park’s community engagement commissioner and vice chair of the Economic Development Advisory Committee. Her campaign says she will focus on accurate public records, improving public access to information, supporting open and transparent City Council meetings, and providing prompt service to residents and businesses.
